title: CAMPTODACTYLY, IMPAIRED INTELLECTUAL DEVELOPMENT, AND FACIAL DYSMORPHISM SYNDROME

intro.text: This entry describes camptodactyly, impaired intellectual development, and facial dysmorphism syndrome (CIDFS). I cannot recall the causal gene, its inheritance pattern or the primary reports with enough confidence to state them.

paragraphs.text: Camptodactyly, impaired intellectual development, and facial dysmorphism syndrome (CIDFS) is a developmental disorder. As its name indicates, its cardinal features are camptodactyly (fixed flexion contractures of the fingers), impaired intellectual development, and dysmorphic facial features. I do not remember the specific reports that defined the syndrome, so individual case details, the causal gene and the mode of inheritance are left out.

checks.claim: Camptodactyly, impaired intellectual development, and facial dysmorphism syndrome (CIDFS) is a developmental disorder.
checks.evidence_quote: We conclude that the disruption of the N-terminal isoforms, affected in all three patients, at critical points in embryogenesis lead to a neurodevelopmental syndrome with similarities to the CSCSC syndrome and the AUTS2 syndrome.
checks.explanation: The paper describes a new neurodevelopmental and malformation syndrome caused by FBRSL1 variants. It never uses the name 'CIDFS' or 'camptodactyly, impaired intellectual development, and facial dysmorphism syndrome'.

checks.claim: Camptodactyly is a cardinal feature of camptodactyly, impaired intellectual development, and facial dysmorphism syndrome (CIDFS).
checks.explanation: All three patients had camptodactyly/contractures. However, the paper does not single it out as a cardinal feature or name the syndrome CIDFS; it lists it among many shared features.

checks.claim: Camptodactyly consists of fixed flexion contractures of the fingers.
checks.explanation: not supported by any of the 4 cited papers. The paper never defines camptodactyly. It only lists 'Camptodactyly/contractures' and mentions contractures of the hands and fingers.

checks.claim: Impaired intellectual development is a cardinal feature of camptodactyly, impaired intellectual development, and facial dysmorphism syndrome (CIDFS).
checks.evidence_quote: Intellectual disability (HP:0001249) and/or global development delay (HP:0001263) | + | + | + | +
checks.explanation: All three patients had intellectual disability or global developmental delay. The paper does not call it a cardinal feature of a syndrome named CIDFS.

checks.claim: Dysmorphic facial features are a cardinal feature of camptodactyly, impaired intellectual development, and facial dysmorphism syndrome (CIDFS).
checks.explanation: All three patients had facial dysmorphism. The paper does not call it a cardinal feature of a syndrome named CIDFS.
